description: How the browser reaches the session and how thimble follows its agents (plugin/bin/.thimble-watch). The watcher wakes the session with each browser event, and permission prompts are relayed to the browser. As each turn of main's begins and ends, the permission mode Claude Code reports for it goes to the server. The turn that ends after /thimble shows the dashboard link in the terminal, where the model does not see it. As each turn of main's begins, the events held for main (an ended orientation, writer or view build, a label) are added to its prompt, and the terminal prints what the analyst wrote in the browser, which Claude Code shows of a woken turn only as the fixed summary. thimble's agents are subagents of main, of the types thimble's plugin module registers (thimble:<role>): their hooks write the workspace's files first and post to the server only when it runs. An Agent or SendMessage call, main's or a subagent's, goes through --agent-check, which lets a start or a follow-up of thimble's agents through only when the analyst asked for it (a pending request in subagents.json) and refuses a second fork of a thread; SubagentStart and SubagentStop record each agent's runs, a PreToolUse hook on thimble's tools records which agent makes each call, PermissionDenied records a start auto mode refused, SessionEnd records main's end and SessionStart for clear and resume moves the agents to the new session. After each call, an agent of thimble's or a descendant of one is told its ref and when its work folder grows past its budget. In a session that is no thimble workspace, each exits at once. The UserPromptExpansion hook of /thimble does the skill's work (bin/thimble server up --hook) just before the skill's commands run, since Claude Code runs hooks outside its Bash sandbox, where a command cannot start or reach thimble's server; the skill's command prints what it left. The SessionStart hook for clear and compact gives main its prompt again (bin/thimble prompt main), which /clear takes out of the conversation and /compact cuts short in a session the launcher did not start, and only when main itself cleared or compacted; it prints nothing in any other session.

hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/thimble" prompt main --unless-launched --if-main --cwd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --lead 'Your thimble prompt follows. /thimble gave it to you, and /clear or /compact has since taken it out of this conversation or cut it short. It is yours for the rest of this session, as if it were part of your system prompt. When Claude Code shows only the start of it and names a file that holds all of it, Read that file before you reply to anything.' 2>/dev/null || true
